raw.details:
Overview:

Axis HackSprint is back bigger, bolder, and designed to bring together the brightest problem-solvers, coders, and innovators. Organized by Axis Institute of Technology & Management (AITM), HackSprint 2.0 provides an open stage to build impactful, scalable solutions addressing real-world challenges using modern technologies.

This is a National-Level, Software-Only Hackathon where top student innovators from across the country compete, build, and showcase functional software prototypes.

Themes & Tracks (Software Only):

  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI/ML)
  • Cyber Security
  • Blockchain Technology
  • Agriculture / AgriTech (Digital Solutions)
  • Healthcare (HealthTech / Digital Health)
  • Gamification & EdTech

Eligibility & Team Guidelines:

  • Event Type: National-level software hackathon (hardware/IoT prototypes are not permitted).
  • Eligibility: Open to all Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and Diploma engineering/technology students across India.
  • Team Size: 2 to 4 members per team.
  • Inter-College Teams: Allowed (students from different institutes can collaborate in the same team).
  • Inter-Specialization Teams: Allowed (cross-branch collaboration is encouraged).
  • A participant cannot be part of more than one team.

Competition Structure & Stages:

Round 1: Online Idea Submission

  • Submission Deadline: 17 October 2026, 11:59 pm
  • What Your PPT Should Include?
    • Problem you are addressing
    • Proposed Solution
    • Existing Similar Work + Your Unique Contribution
    • Workflow chart (video optional)
    • Tech stack you will use
    • Real-world feasibility supported by credible research & references.
  • Avoid:
    • Vague or purely conceptual ideas
    • Unnecessary slides
    • Design-heavy templates with little technical substance
  • Your presentation should clearly communicate how the idea will be built, not just describe it at a high level. Join the WhatsApp group here: https://chat.whatsapp.com/GQ98gaA9Odv92R8nSJtJjL
  • Results Announcement: 20 October 2026

Round 2: Grand Finale (12-Hour On-Campus Hackathon):

  • Date: 3 November 2026
  • Venue: AITM Campus, Axis Colleges, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh
  • Format: A continuous 12-hour offline coding sprint, live prototype build, mentorship rounds, and final jury evaluations.
  • Detailed Schedule: The hour-by-hour itinerary of the finale will be announced soon.

Registration & Participation Fee:

  • Free of cost.

Prizes & Perks:

  • Cash Prize Pool: ₹25,000.
  • Venue Hospitality: Complimentary lunch and refreshments provided for all attending finalist teams.
  • Participant Goodies: Exclusive event goodies for offline finalists.
  • Certificates: Official Participation Certificates for all finalists attending the venue, along with Merit Certificates for the podium winners.

Rules & Evaluation Criteria:

  • All development work must be carried out during the hackathon hours. Pre-built software solutions or templates are strictly prohibited.
  • Projects must be pushed to a public GitHub repository; regular commit activity will be monitored throughout the offline hackathon.
  • The decisions of the organizing committee and panel of judges are final and binding.
